_meta.name: Hyperliquid HyperEVM CoreWriter System Contract — send trading actions FROM smart contracts to HyperCore
_meta.note: Burns ~25,000 gas, emits log processed by HyperCore. Orders delayed by a few seconds to prevent mempool front-running advantage.

perp_oracle_price.note: Query oracle price for perp asset by index. Returns uint256. Divide by 10^(6-szDecimals).

spot_oracle_price.note: Query oracle price for spot asset by index.

encoding.order: limitPx and sz: send as 10^8 * human value
encoding.cloid: 0 = no cloid, else use as client order ID
